# Stage-X.Space — Forward Deployed Engineering & Enterprise AI Summits

> Stage-X.Space is an elite forward-deployed engineering practice and research consultancy bridging frontier AI research labs and operational reality. Specializing in taking frontier models into hardened, deterministic production microservices with sub-500ms latency, enterprise RAG systems, air-gapped agentic orchestration, and closed-door executive technical summits.
> Canonical Domain: https://stage-x.space/ | Contact: connect@stage-x.space

## Forward Deployed Engineering Capabilities
- **Deterministic Low-Latency Inference**: Production deployment of frontier LLMs with sub-50ms Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) and deterministic execution boundaries.
- **Production-Grade Enterprise RAG**: Hybrid vector and knowledge graph indexing architectures with dynamic reranking, metadata filtering, and hallucination guardrails.
- **Agentic Workflow Orchestration**: Autonomous multi-agent pipelines with strict state machines, fault isolation, tool sandboxing, and audit logs.
- **Sovereign & Air-Gapped Deployments**: On-premise, VPC, and edge model hosting ensuring zero data leakage, GDPR compliance, and EU AI Act regulatory alignment.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **What is Forward Deployed Engineering?** Senior AI engineers embed directly with client engineering teams to build, harden, and transition mission-critical AI systems directly into operational codebase repos.
- **How can enterprise leaders apply for summit seats?** Applications are vetted based on technical leadership roles (CTO, VP Engineering, Head of AI Research) at https://www.stage-x.space/summits.html.
- **Are summit discussions published?** No. Summits operate under the Chatham House Rule to encourage candid disclosure of production failures and hardware bottlenecks.
